B284-1 repair: republishActivity captures the observed state when enqueued, rather than reading the newest state when its serialized callback runs. A failed obsolete state returns before activityDelay, including when superseded before its first send. The existing post-wait attempt>0 guard remains. Cost of this repair is a captured existing state plus a constant-time comparison; it avoids the obsolete first retry sleep and introduces no new request trigger, history, loop, timer or launch site beyond round one.

| Changed path | Final static cost and scaling |
| --- | --- |
| Registration activity | One extra healthy primary POST per successful registration with a known observed state and supported route; zero with unknown state/unsupported route. Sum successful-registration rates across native extensions. |
| Publication retries | Original plus at most five primary retries per publication. Waits 1,2,5,10,30 seconds: 48 seconds scheduled sleep, not a wall bound. Plan217's existing 400/422 fallback may add one state-only POST per attempt; conservative total at most12 logical RPCs/publication. |
| Timer/serialization | The bounded retry loop HAS its own activityDelay sleep timer; at most five new waits/publication and one active activity retry wait/bridge. No new recurring poller. The serialized Promise queue is not a hard lifetime/depth cap. |
| Retry lifetime | Per publication, NOT per outage or state lifetime. Exhaustion resets activityState; a subsequent same-state event can start another episode. This is explicitly covered by the adopted two-episode cap regression. |
| Busy native batches | Floor is per background job/source, not per aggregate owner. Owner rates add across jobs; default60s offers at most1/60 batch/s/job, subject to the existing100ms tick and pending work. I=0 remains allowed and tick-limited. |
| Eligible busy-job reads | Once the floor passes, up to10 event_stats checks/s/job, each two explicit SQL reads (schema + COUNT/SUM/MAX across retained job history). Offered work scales O(10*sum historical rows), even when no event is pending. No new per-tick subprocess site. |

For Q publication episodes actually offered across N seats: primary retry attempts<=5Q, primary total<=6Q, fallback-inclusive logical posts<=12Q and retry-wait arms<=5Q. These are source bounds, not measured traffic. Existing request deadlines and delivery/cold-routing work remain; unchanged launch inventory is not a claim that all resulting work launches nothing or wakes no model.
